_about: Minority-view recall seeds for the 3-document test run. Each is a view the text attributes to someone other than the author, often in a clause or two. Written by Claude from reading the sources BEFORE looking at the extraction output (2026-11-11). expected_voice = how the author treats it. A seed counts as found if some mention carries the same view with a compatible holder.
